company.name: Circyls
company.shortDescription: Circyls is mobile app that help users to join public ones while ensuring authenticity, covers defaults and prevent frauds
company.description: Circlys is a fintech established and operating in Saudi Arabia since 2017 is focus currently on providing public roscas (rotating credit and saving associate) for members who needed to join a circle and does not have private circles around then and its revenue comes from subscription fees based on the slot (month and value of contribution ) selected, it approved by SAMA (Saudi Arabia central bank) and has placed a strong risk-based framework to onboard customers with different risk profiles which might not profitable or targeted by traditional financial insinuations while keeping default rate within the industry average.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Equity Crowdfunding round raised $1,333,186, or 69.71% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $320,000 to $24,037,875, a 75.12x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 67 (+1 over 90 days) and market heat at 76 (+0).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
